name: DWO Hall of Fame
epitaph: Inducted its only class on the promotion's own last card, Final Fight, honoring the wrestlers and operators who built the Deadly Wrestling Organization before its doors closed for good.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: The promotion's own first World Heavyweight Champion, inducted first.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Inducted in absentia as early DWO World Tag Team Champions.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Announces his retirement from wrestling on accepting the honor.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Inducted in absentia; billed the co-headliner, with Rick Styles, of a rival promotion's New Alliance.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Inducted the same night he lost the DWO World Heavyweight Championship.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Inducted in absentia as the Mahmood Brothers, billed multiple-time DWO Tag Team Champions.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Inducted after leaving the arena and being fired from the promotion earlier the same night.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Thanks his own trainers, rival and father in his induction speech.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Inducted the same night he won the promotion's own last match.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Inducted in absentia, having left for an early flight; a statement is read on his behalf.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Accepts an inscribed plaque for service to the promotion.

bestowals.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999), the promotion's own Hall of Fame ceremony.
bestowals.vote_detail: Inducted last, as the promotion's own founders; Mike Bilodeau closes the ceremony by declaring the DWO closed.
